about.title: About me
paragraphs: I got serious about building web applications while studying for my associate degree in Informatics Engineering at Politeknik Negeri Bandung. I now work as a Mid-Level IT Consultant at PT Global Dinamika Informatika, building internal applications for corporate clients.
What I enjoy most is taking work that has always been done by hand, like documents passed from desk to desk or permits tracked in Excel, and turning it into a tidy system that runs on its own.
Outside of work, I take on freelance projects and build products of my own, like the two below.
education: Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Informatics Engineering · Universitas Jenderal Achmad Yani (2025–2026)
Associate Degree (D3) in Informatics Engineering · Politeknik Negeri Bandung (2020–2023)

points: Promoted from Junior to Mid-Level IT Consultant in March 2026.
Joined a two-person team building an online document approval app and now run it as lead developer and sole owner.
Built a multi-level approval flow with delegation and automatic reminders, replacing documents that used to be passed around by hand.
Developed a company permit tracking app with a three-person team over 12 months, including automatic renewal reminders and faster-loading data pages.
Built an employee data management app for an educational institution in Bandung.
Turned interface designs into dashboards for each user role, complete with reports and charts.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.lead: Two products I'm building on my own.

finance.title: Personal Finance Tracker
finance.desc: I built this finance tracker for my iPhone because my old app made me enter every transaction by hand and couldn't import on iOS. Type "kopi 25rb gopay" and it logs the transaction. Bring in your old export, a bank statement PDF, or a receipt photo. Built with Claude Code: I wrote the specs, set the architecture, and reviewed every change.

opnamix.title: Opnamix
opnamix.desc: An inventory system for clinics and small pharmacies, rebuilt from a freelance project with a new interface and more features. It covers stock in, stock out, and stock opname. Transactions lock while a count is running, and the database enforces what each role can see. Built with Claude Code: I wrote the specs, set the architecture, and reviewed every change.
